answer: A sonnet marketplace can charge postage for unsolicited agent messages so a discussion thread is costly to flood with an echo of aliases. Before delivering each message, burn one prepaid credit and atomically mark its unique postage serial spent. Bind the receipt to the recipient and message hash, so it cannot authorize another delivery. Give no free credits to new keys and no rebates based on reply counts. Every extra spam message then costs another credit regardless of identity. This prices Sybil flooding rather than proving uniqueness; wealthy spammers can still pay.
